env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A hoisted call operand, a received value, the result of && and a switch
# tag whose type is an unexported type of another package take part in the
# hoist of a go group child, natively and in the ejected module.
cd a
logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds and runs with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ../..

-- a/go.mod --
module example.com/hidden

go 1.27
-- a/b/b.lgo --
package b

type hidden struct{ N int }

type hiddenBool bool

func Make(n int) hidden { return hidden{n} }

func MakeOrdered(n int, order *int) hidden {
	if *order != 0 {
		panic("hidden operand evaluated more than once")
	}
	*order = 1
	return Make(n)
}

func Blocked() chan hidden { return nil }

func Chan(n int) chan hidden {
	c := make(chan hidden, 1)
	c <- hidden{n}
	return c
}

func Flag(v bool) hiddenBool { return hiddenBool(v) }

func Show(h hidden, v int) int { return h.N*10 + v }

func Take(v hiddenBool) int {
	if v {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}
-- a/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/hidden/b"
)

func ordered(in chan int, order *int) chan int {
	if *order != 1 {
		panic("receive ran before hidden operand")
	}
	*order = 2
	return in
}

func plain(ctx context.Context, in chan int, out *int) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			order := 0
			*out = b.Show(b.MakeOrdered(2, &order), <-ordered(in, &order))
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func elem(ctx context.Context, out *int) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			h := <-b.Chan(3)
			*out = b.Show(h, 1)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func flag(ctx context.Context, in chan int, out *int) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			*out = b.Take(b.Flag(true) && <-in == 1)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func tag(ctx context.Context, in chan int, out *int) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			switch b.Make(2) {
			case b.Make(<-in):
				*out = 1
			default:
				*out = 2
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func feed(v int) chan int {
	in := make(chan int, 1)
	in <- v
	return in
}

func check(name string, err error, got, want int) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	if got != want {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: got %d, want %d", name, got, want))
	}
	fmt.Println("ok", name)
}

func elemCancel(ctx context.Context, out *int) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			h := <-b.Blocked()
			*out = b.Show(h, 1)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func cancelled(name string, run func(context.Context, *int) error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	cancel()
	var out int
	err := run(ctx, &out)
	if !errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("%s: cancellation error %v", name, err))
	}
	if out != 0 {
		panic(name + ": evaluated after cancellation")
	}
	fmt.Println("ok", name)
}

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	var out int
	err := plain(ctx, feed(5), &out)
	check("hidden-operand", err, out, 25)
	out = 0
	err = elem(ctx, &out)
	check("hidden-element", err, out, 31)
	out = 0
	err = flag(ctx, feed(1), &out)
	check("hidden-boolean", err, out, 1)
	out = 0
	err = tag(ctx, feed(2), &out)
	check("hidden-tag", err, out, 1)
	cancelled("hidden-element-cancel", elemCancel)
	cancelled("hidden-boolean-cancel", func(ctx context.Context, out *int) error {
		return flag(ctx, nil, out)
	})
	cancelled("hidden-tag-cancel", func(ctx context.Context, out *int) error {
		return tag(ctx, nil, out)
	})
}
